duration.text: The Vehicle Engineering at Chongqing Jiaotong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 8. Certification of no criminal record 9. Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, under 45 years old, with a Bachelor’s Degree before the coming September or having worked for 2 years after graduation from a 2/3-year program, excellent academic performance, passed HSK 4
